summary: Travel, trade goods and transport passengers in this cozy train tycoon adventure
description:
Journey out on a relaxing train simulator adventure with Tiny Rails - an idle railroad tycoon with cozy pixel graphics. Travel the world, trade goods, transport passengers and collect unique wagons - all at your own pace 🚂💨

A COZY TRAIN SIMULATOR ADVENTURE AWAITS
- Enjoy active play and idle progress
- Customize your train with hundreds of unique combinations
- Explore cities and landmarks
- Collect and continuously upgrade your trains and wagons
- Delight in cozy pixel graphics and soothing music
- Trade goods at the many markets
- Buy train stations worldwide and become a railroad tycoon

TRAVEL THE WORLD
In Tiny Rails you can set your destination via the map and travel through continents where you can discover renowned landmarks. Experience places such as Mount Rushmore, the Pyramids of Giza, the Great Wall of China, the Colosseum, and the Taj Mahal. 

TRADE GOODS AND CONNECT PASSENGERS
Transport passengers across continents, connecting them with loved ones. Customize your train with amenities to keep travelers comfortable and entertained, earning their satisfaction. Visit the cozy market awaiting you at each station where you can trade the goods you carry - look out for high demand and a good bargain like a true tycoon! Even while you're idle, your trains will continue to operate, generating revenue and propelling your train simulator adventure forward.

COLLECT AND UPGRADE
Collect a fleet of unique and cozy train wagons, each with its own characteristics and customization options. Enhance their speed, passenger capacity, and cargo weight to optimize your railroad routes and maximize profits.

RELAXING GAMEPLAY
With a focus on idle gameplay, Tiny Rails allows you to progress even when you're not actively playing, ensuring that your train keeps chugging along the cozy environments and generating revenue. The tycoon adventure begins today!

Tiny Rails is a free to play train simulator tycoon, however, some game items can be purchased for real money. If you don’t want to use this feature, disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings. Read the Trophy Games Privacy Statement to know more about your data protection: https://trophy-games.com/legal/privacy-statement
